welcome.title: Gridlume: your whole infrastructure on one map
welcome.lead: The map is empty for now. Soon your machines, routers, cloud and the links between them will be here.
welcome.s1.d: Places, machines, routers, cloud and the links between them — by hand, in a few minutes.
welcome.s2.d: One command installs the agent: CPU, memory, disks and containers appear by themselves.
welcome.s3.d: One cause — one clear Telegram message, no storm of alerts.
